verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers extraction, loading, dbt transformations, orchestration via Airflow, and plugin architecture, but nothing addresses lineage tracking or visualization — no mention of a lineage graph, column/table provenance metadata, or lineage UI. This is a reasonable ask for an ELT/orchestration tool, but no evidence shows Meltano surfaces end-to-end lineage of sources/steps/transformations per table.
